name: Flex: Down Screen
idea: If the flex cut is covered, the passer screens down for the screener, who pops up to the top for a shot.
why: The defense is busy stopping the flex cut, so nobody is ready for the second screen. The player who just set a screen gets screened, and pops up wide open. Every flex has two chances to score.
tryit: Down screener: as soon as the cutter goes, run down and stand still next to the screener's defender. Screener: wait for it, then pop up to the top with your hands ready to shoot.

frames.say: Blue is set up in the *flex*. This time, watch {1} and {5}.
*Pass across:* {1} passes over to {4} to start the flex.
*Flex screen:* {5} steps out from the block and screens {X3}.
{3} cuts along the baseline, but {X4} jumps in the way with hands up. {4} can't pass inside.
*Down screen:* {1} runs down and screens {X5}, and {5} pops up to the top. {X5} is stuck, and {X3} runs back to {3}.
Swish! The screener got screened. When the flex cut is covered, look for the down screen.
